_comment: Hard-macro instances outside the size limits (MACRO-1; Daniel, 2026-11-17; tools/check-ngd.py, docs/rtl-coding-style.md 'Hard macros'): one register file (ccv_common_rf_1r1w, _be) holds CCV_MACRO_RF_MIN_BYTES to CCV_MACRO_RF_MAX_BYTES (512 B to 8 KiB), one SRAM (ccv_common_sram_1rw) CCV_MACRO_SRAM_MIN_BYTES to CCV_MACRO_SRAM_MAX_BYTES (4 KiB to 32 KiB), W x D / 8 bytes at its unit's parameters, each bound allowed. A waiver is the last resort, one per instance: module, instance (the cell name check-ngd reports, e.g. g_banks[0].u_data), macro, W, D (exactly the size it excuses: a change fails again), why (the justification: what the array holds, why it cannot be resized, split or built from flops, and what was measured), by and date. A waiver that excuses nothing, or lacks a field, is refused.
